title: The Blue Notebook Review - September 29 - October 4
description:
We’re taking you out into the community as Sgt. Verbeck and our Neighborhood Resource Officers go LIVE at the Vons Grand Opening! 🛒🚓

🐶 Meet our Pet of the Week, learn about the latest arrests, investigations, and notable cases from across Santa Monica, and get a front-row seat to some unfiltered behind-the-scenes outtakes that’ll have you laughing out loud.

From crime prevention to community connections, the Blue Notebook gives you an inside look at your Santa Monica Police Department.

👉 Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe to stay in the loop every week!
